display.purpose: Empty-state heading when no document is open.

title.purpose: Panel headings such as Form, Bookmarks and Pages.

wordmark.purpose: The PDFree name in the first toolbar row.

label.purpose: Status text, zoom readout, hints and small notices.

breakpoints.name: fit-toggle
breakpoints.purpose: Fit width / Fit page toggle appears at this window width and above.

components.name: Toolbar button
components.description: Slint standard button in the toolbar rows; takes the platform palette, no custom fill.
components.css: .ds-toolbar-btn { background: #ffffff; color: #223b54; border: 1px solid #dbe3ec; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: inherit; } .ds-toolbar-btn:hover { background: #f4f6f9; } .ds-toolbar-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #146bca; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-toolbar-btn:disabled { color: #9db0c3; }

components.name: Floating search
components.description: Search bar floating over the document, centred at the top of the viewport.
components.html: 3 of 12
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 580px; max-width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dbe3ec; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; height: 28px; border: 1px solid #dbe3ec; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #223b54; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #146bca; outline-offset: 0; } .ds-search-status { font-size: 12px; color: #526171; }

components.name: Modal dialog
components.description: Decision dialog centred over a dimmed scrim, used for unsaved changes, notes and page tools.
components.html:
Save your changes?

This PDF has unsaved changes.
components.css: .ds-modal { width: 520px; max-width: 100%; padding: 20px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #dbe3ec; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; } .ds-modal-title { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; color: #223b54; } .ds-modal-body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #526171; } .ds-modal-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; }

components.name: Form field overlay
components.description: Tinted overlay on a detected or authored form field; selected fields get a stronger outline.
components.css: .ds-field { background: rgba(70,158,243,0.063); border: 1px solid #146bca; border-radius: 0; box-sizing: border-box; width: 160px; height: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field-selected { background: rgba(70,158,243,0.145); border-width: 2px; } .ds-field-review { border-color: #d68c00; }

components.name: Page sheet
components.description: The document page on the canvas. Always white, sharp-cornered, in both modes.
components.css: .ds-page { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dbe3ec; width: 320px; height: 414px; box-sizing: border-box; }

narrative.overview: PDFree is a tool that lives on the desk, not in a browser tab. Its chrome is a set of close-to-hand controls arranged in fixed bars, the way a workbench keeps its tools in reach. Everything it needs is local, so the interface never implies that a file is leaving the machine. The page is the work, and the controls are arranged around it for fast, repeated use.
keyCharacteristics: Two fixed toolbar rows (44px and 38px) above the document, and a 32px status bar below it.
Tonal layering for depth, with light and dark modes that flip every surface value.
One functional blue accent, used only for working state.
Pages render on pure white in both modes, so the document reads the same either way.
Dense controls with compact spacing, sized for long sessions.

rules.name: The Page Is Always White Rule
rules.body: The document page is #ffffff in both modes. Dark mode darkens the chrome and the canvas, never the page.

rules.name: The Working Blue Rule
rules.body: Workbench Blue marks what the user is working on: focus, selection, and the wordmark. It never marks a decorative element or a passive state.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: Body and label carry almost all of the interface. Use display and title only for the empty state and panel headings. Do not add a third intermediate size.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: Depth is a change in surface value, not a shadow. A panel is one step lighter or darker than the layer beneath it.

dos: Do keep the page #ffffff in both modes.
Do reserve Workbench Blue for focus, selection and the wordmark.
Do create depth with a tonal step between surfaces, never with a drop shadow.
Do keep body text at 14px and labels at 12px, and use display or title sizes only for headings.
Do make a new panel resizable from its inner edge, within its documented min and max width.
Do keep modal decisions to the smallest set of buttons the choice needs.
donts: Don't add drop shadows to panels, dialogs or the page.
Don't use gradients or a bright marketing palette.
Don't imply that a file is uploaded or leaves the machine, in copy or in visuals.
Don't use the amber Warning colours for decoration.
Don't add a third intermediate type size.
Don't add new emoji icons; new icons follow the monoline target.
